view: AP frontal (portable, supine/semi-erect); L marker at image top-right, conventional orientation
technical_quality: Adequate penetration but patient rotated to the left with tilted/oblique collimation; apices included, costophrenic angles partly cut off and obscured; multiple overlying ECG electrodes, cables and a pleural catheter limit assessment of the left lateral pleural space

devices.location: Left hemithorax; coil projected over the lateral left mid zone, tube runs down the lateral left chest wall to a hub/connector at the left lower lateral chest / upper abdomen level, then continues off the film
Right upper anterior chest (infraclavicular); wire courses inferomedially across the right lung toward the lower mediastinum
Left upper anterior chest (infraclavicular); wire courses downward along the left axilla / lateral chest wall
Right lateral chest / right upper arm region (image far left), wire looping outside the thorax
One crossing the right shoulder-upper chest, one curving across the lower chest / upper abdomen from right to left, and coiled cables at the left lower corner of the film outside the patient
Image top-right, over the left shoulder region

abnormalities.finding: Diffuse coarse reticulonodular and patchy airspace opacities throughout both lungs, right more than left
Increased homogeneous density of the right lower zone with obscured right hemidiaphragm and costophrenic angle, suggesting consolidation and/or layering pleural effusion

Possible thin lucent rim without lung markings lateral to the lung adjacent to the pigtail coil, but no definite visceral pleural line; cannot be separated from an adjacent broad soft-tissue/skin-fold band along the left lateral chest wall (pneumothorax mimic)
Broad smooth soft-tissue density band curving from below the left clavicle down the lateral left chest wall, most consistent with a skin fold
Right heart border partially obscured by adjacent lung opacity; cardiomediastinal contour otherwise difficult to assess on rotated AP film

description_zh: AP 胸部X光，病人有旋轉且照野歪斜。左側胸腔可見一條 pigtail 引流導管，其捲曲末端投影於左中肺野外側，導管沿左側胸壁外側向下走行至左下胸／上腹部之接頭，顯示左側氣胸已置管引流；目前未見明確臟層肋膜線，僅於 pigtail 附近之左側外側肺野疑有薄層無肺紋透亮區，但與沿左側胸壁的軟組織／皮膚皺褶帶影難以區分，殘餘氣胸無法確認。兩側肺野瀰漫性粗網狀結節及斑片狀浸潤，右側較明顯，右下肺野密度增加並使右橫膈及肋膈角模糊，疑為實質化合併肋膜積液。另見雙側前胸心電圖電極貼片及多條導線投影於胸部。
